attempts.why: THE ONE THAT MUST CHANGE. The assistant asked 'Are you sure you would like me to cancel your appointment?' and the caller said yes -- agreed_now=true, recorded by the probe. The appointment was unique, on file, and had been read to the caller at 00:41:57 ('Friday, September eighteenth, at three PM'). A human receptionist cancels here. The gate refused because the confirming sentence named no time, which is a fact about the model's wording and not about whether this caller consented. Until a read-back is something the system OWNS rather than something it parses out of the model's speech, this attempt refuses and the caller loses the thing they rang to do.
